alignment_groups.label: epistemic-standing-inquiry-and-warrant
alignment_groups.shared_structure: a subject or community distinguishes appearance, belief, testimony, inference, doubt, warrant and reliable knowing
alignment_groups.preserved_structure: claim standing depends on knower, method, source, defeater and certification condition
alignment_groups.cannot_merge: pramāṇa, Buddhist valid cognition, falsafa demonstration, Diné learning, colonial standpoint and Cartesian certainty remain distinct

alignment_groups.label: normative-practical-formation-and-good-living
alignment_groups.shared_structure: conduct is evaluated through cultivated disposition, purpose, relation, obligation, practical judgment and consequences
alignment_groups.preserved_structure: good action depends on role, practice, context, affected parties and a declared normative source
alignment_groups.cannot_merge: virtue, liberation, ritual, law, harmony, justice and community good are not one scale

alignment_groups.label: agency-personhood-self-and-responsibility
alignment_groups.shared_structure: person or agent is formed through capacities, relations, judgment, action, constraint and responsibility
alignment_groups.preserved_structure: agency varies with standing, role, causal condition, social relation and cultivated response
alignment_groups.cannot_merge: ātman, anātman, volition, autonomy, destiny, ubuntu personhood, relational loob/kapwa and Levinasian subjectivity conflict

alignment_groups.label: experience-affect-desire-and-well-being
alignment_groups.shared_structure: felt, perceptual and affective states shape attention, belief, desire, judgment and action
alignment_groups.preserved_structure: experience has subject, object, valence, temporal course, interpretation and practical effect
alignment_groups.cannot_merge: pleasure, passion, moral emotion, luminous presence and culturally formed rasa are not interchangeable

alignment_groups.label: metaphysical-dependence-manifestation-and-whole-part
alignment_groups.shared_structure: accounts distinguish what exists independently, dependently, conventionally, as part, as form or as manifestation
alignment_groups.preserved_structure: ontological claims require declared level, dependence relation and identity criterion
alignment_groups.cannot_merge: Forms, substance, śūnyatā, svabhāva, li/qi, essence/existence and divine manifestation are incompatible analyses

alignment_groups.label: meaning-interpretation-language-and-transmission
alignment_groups.shared_structure: meaning arises through sign or text, use, interpreter, language, practice, audience, authority and transmission history
alignment_groups.preserved_structure: interpretation is directional, contextual, revisable and lossy
alignment_groups.cannot_merge: Mīmāṃsā force, hermeneutics, rule-following, doctrinal classification, translation and oral reception have different warrants

alignment_groups.label: social-political-authority-plurality-and-legitimacy
alignment_groups.shared_structure: collective action distributes standing, office, obligation, deliberation, dissent, legitimacy and coercive power
alignment_groups.preserved_structure: authority depends on source, constituency, procedure, scope, accountability and contestability
alignment_groups.cannot_merge: Confederacy council, Legalist instruments, rabbinic authority, justice, chiefly roles, kastom and public action are not one governance model

alignment_groups.label: historical-colonial-category-and-institutional-power
alignment_groups.shared_structure: institutions and inherited classifications shape identity, knowledge, labor, archive and available action over time
alignment_groups.preserved_structure: a power claim needs named actor, institution, mechanism, subject position, history and dissent
alignment_groups.cannot_merge: genealogy, coloniality, racialization, empire, state canonization, militarization and repression are not one causal label

alignment_groups.label: performance-archive-research-and-knowledge-custody
alignment_groups.shared_structure: knowledge warrant depends on speaker or performer, audience, occasion, genre, archive, authority to share, consent, return and validation
alignment_groups.preserved_structure: source custody is part of the claim rather than a detachable citation
alignment_groups.cannot_merge: dialogue, epic, oral sage argument, Yolŋu performance, talanoa and community research have distinct authorities

alignment_groups.label: land-genealogy-relation-reciprocity-and-opacity
alignment_groups.shared_structure: persons and obligations can be constituted through land or ocean, genealogy, kin, reciprocal care and limits on transparent representation
alignment_groups.preserved_structure: relation needs local roles, place, history, asymmetry, time horizon, refusal and authority
alignment_groups.cannot_merge: whenua, wäŋa, pacha, ʻāina, fonua, vanua, vā, ayllu, opacity and inafa'maolek are non-equivalent

conflict_groups.label: same-gloss-non-equivalence
conflict_groups.conflict: balance, harmony, relation, reciprocity, law, duty, freedom, self, knowledge and good life recur without exact equivalence
conflict_groups.decision: reject gloss-led exact mappings; require direction, language, context and loss

conflict_groups.label: description-to-normative-guidance
conflict_groups.conflict: historical or community descriptions could be rendered as advice, policy or moral ranking
conflict_groups.decision: reject every automatic normative uptake; qualified review remains mandatory

conflict_groups.label: publication-to-authority-to-share
conflict_groups.conflict: public text, transcript or archive could be treated as permission or ownership
conflict_groups.decision: reject access-equals-authority; retain restricted and ceremonial absences

conflict_groups.label: state-canon-and-archive-appropriation
conflict_groups.conflict: national, colonial, state, heritage and academic institutions both preserve and reassign authority
conflict_groups.decision: require named institution, mechanism, represented party, dissent and custody

conflict_groups.label: metaphysical-and-operational-false-friends
conflict_groups.conflict: form, matter, substance, mode, cause, law, person and value resemble current operational terms while owning different senses
conflict_groups.decision: reject direct owner matches; retain scoped philosophical analyses

conflict_groups.label: consensus-harmony-and-suppressed-dissent
conflict_groups.conflict: agreement or harmony may arise through living procedure, hierarchy, repair, exclusion or coercion
conflict_groups.decision: require role, procedure, authority, dissent, refusal and power rather than an outcome score

conflict_groups.label: universal-person-and-self-model
conflict_groups.conflict: individual, relational, no-self, socially achieved, divinely related and land-genealogical personhood cannot share one ontology
conflict_groups.decision: retain agency/identity overlap but reject a universal person schema

unmapped_definition: These records may participate in a broad analogy or conflict group but have no defensible mapping to a current or proposed Factorium owner; group membership is not semantic equivalence.

unmapped_factorings.reason: Platonic form and justice remain coupled beyond current owners.
Advaita reality and identification levels admit no safe generic mapping.
Intrinsic nature and dependent designation remain a tradition dispute, not an identity rule.
Han correlative cosmology is not a generic correspondence mechanism.
Akbarian manifestation and divine names remain scoped theological metaphysics.
Skovoroda's affinity and inner nature remain a source-local life analysis.
Opacity limits the mapping itself and cannot become a missing-value code.
Living Great Law authority cannot be owned by a generic governance table.
Yolŋu performance and Bothways authority cannot be reduced to interoperability.
Ea and ʻike authority remain politically and collectively bounded.

owner_candidates.label: epistemic standing, inquiry and warrant boundary
owner_candidates.product_decision: design one canonical boundary entry or claim/evidence companion view; do not encode tradition-specific epistemologies

owner_candidates.label: semantic meaning, interpretation and transmission boundary
owner_candidates.product_decision: design one meaning/interpretation boundary entry distinct from information and encoding

owner_candidates.label: source, performance and research custody view
owner_candidates.product_decision: design a derived evidence-custody view spanning speaker, authority-to-share, audience, archive, consent, return and validation

owner_candidates.label: human agency and relational personhood elaboration
owner_candidates.product_decision: elaborate the agency root with scoped contrasts; create no universal person ontology

deferred_and_rejected_mappings.reason: recurrence passes but the family conflates virtue, justice, liberation, obligation, harmony and community good
the family needs subject/object, affect, desire and well-being splits

deferred_and_rejected_mappings.target: named thinker, school, nation, religion or community entries
deferred_and_rejected_mappings.reason: proper-name recurrence is provenance and navigation, not a reusable concept owner

deferred_and_rejected_mappings.target: universal relation, harmony, reciprocity or good-life dimensions
deferred_and_rejected_mappings.reason: same gloss conceals incompatible roles, power and custody
the frozen portfolio is a counter-sample, not exhaustive coverage

custody_rule: Every source factoring appears exactly once in the primary output ledger; secondary conflicts and unmapped status append without altering that source-local record.
